purpose: GIS Store V21 Studio integration: location maps, IDW interpolation, permanent backend boundary resolution and A4 landscape publication layouts
notes: Location-map camera uses the uploaded CSV point extent as the authoritative automatic viewport.
Asynchronous permanent boundary resolution redraws boundaries without changing the automatic CSV viewport.
Clicking a project CSV layer explicitly fits all features in that layer; clicking a project boundary explicitly fits that boundary.
Custom boundary upload requests an explicit boundary focus but never expands an unrelated boundary to include outlying CSV points.
Map camera fitting uses bounded padding and a 16.5 maximum zoom so compact point datasets remain readable while all points stay visible.
A4 location layout uses boundary plus points in the main frame only when every sampling point is inside the boundary; otherwise it keeps the point-focused main frame and boundary overview.
The custom boundary remains a visible project layer with its delete control.
The permanent boundary API and existing remove-boundary implementation are unchanged.
